data.one_liner: Check and request app permissions across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified API to check, request, and listen to permission states across multiple platforms. Supports a wide range of specific permissions including camera, location, Bluetooth, and platform-specific options like battery optimization or notifications.
use_when: You need to handle device permissions across all six Flutter platforms with a single API.
Your application requires streaming permission status changes in real-time.
avoid_when: You are already using an established ecosystem alternative like permission_handler and do not require cross-platform support for Linux/Windows via this specific plugin.
strengths: Supports all six Flutter platforms including Linux and Windows.
Real-time updates via permission status streams.
Granular support for Android 13 media permissions and specialized options.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of platform-specific files like AndroidManifest.xml, Info.plist, and macOS entitlements.
Some permissions are limited or unsupported on specific platforms like the Web.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding permissions and usage descriptions to AndroidManifest.xml, iOS Info.plist, and macOS Info.plist/Entitlements files.

alternatives.name: permission_handler
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the most popular, battle-tested permission management plugin in the Flutter ecosystem.
